record.issue_text: packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts:1078 — evt.destinationCalendar is null when organizer/eventType has none, so `?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` silently drops collective hosts' calendars.

adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Immediately after, for collective team events it does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, the optional chaining prevents the push, so collected `teamDestinationCalendars` are dropped and no destination calendars are created for those hosts. This is a correctness issue verifiable in the diff.
